blocks: apps/api/tests/unit/sagaIntegration.init.test.ts::should configure command executor for saga steps
subject: apps/api/src/saga/SagaIntegration.ts
note: The ledger row has no subject; the block's title names the command executor SagaIntegration hands the post-publishing saga definition in `registerSagaDefinitions`. VACUOUS on the first mutation, the executor dropping its return; the alternative recorded here drops the registration of the definitions from `initialize()`, so no saga step has an executor. The block calls the CQRS bus double directly after `initialize()` and reads that double's own result, never the executor.

subject: apps/api/src/trends/trendAnalysisService.ts

subject: packages/core/compliance/src/ComplianceService.ts
note: The ledger row's subject. The block's title names a status filter the repository applies, which the suite's double replaces; its verdict is that a DSAR request with no pending request for its email is accepted. The check of the pending count is inverted, so a count the repository returns makes `submitDsarRequest` fail with DATABASE_ERROR.
